projectDescription:
[[en]]A documentation project recording abstract artists talking about work that, they insist, is not about anything. Interviews took place in studios, galleries, one disused swimming pool and a lift that was stuck between floors. The artists speak Kürbinian, Edolo, Tok Pisin and several languages they describe as "still being invented".
